notes.title: "Immortus Temporus" is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

At the end of 2020, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/491720/view/4498498185069811906]I told you[/url] that I was ready to move on to a more ambitious project, and... Today the game I was hoping to make officially became available on Steam! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609030]Immortus Temporus[/url] is an action puzzle for people who love to find optimal ways to complete the game and beat it faster than anybody else. Most of the levels in "IT" have multiple solutions, which require players to think outside of the box and break the rules of this game. For instance, if you crash into a hazard, you will deactivate it for the duration of the level and teleport back to the spawn point, which might help you get where you want faster.

I'm super proud of "Immortus Temporus" and I'm 100% certain that it's the best project I've ever worked on. I'm excited to release this game to the public eye, and I'd love to hear your thoughts about it! ːsteamhappyː

If you'd like see how this game feels to play, please check out this let's play by Rayk: [previewyoutube=bsDI2hYRzck;full][/previewyoutube]
If you are curious about how this game was made, I made two 5-minute-long devlogs on my YouTube channel, where I tried to describe how this game came to life and how I came up with its puzzles:
[previewyoutube=LuQ1P8ewn7g;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=71Yg_WZeCx4;full][/previewyoutube]
And if you'd like to get weekly summaries of what I'm working on, as well as take a peek "behind the things" of what I'm doing, please consider following me on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Khud0]Patreon[/url]!

Thank you for reading this announcement, have a splendid day! ːgrizzland_heartː

Yours forever,
Ivan Zlobin (Khud0)

notes.title: Shatris is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

If you told me a bit more than a year ago that some day I'll release a puzzle game, I'd doubt your words. What happened instead is that I now have 2 puzzle games on Steam, released in the same year! Ladies and gentlemen, meet [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301830/Shatris_Infinite_Puzzles/]Shatris[/url]!

The reason I made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227860/Plastris/]Plastris[/url] is that I wanted to get used to a new game engine. I decided to transition from GameMaker to Unity and didn't want to make some engine-specific mistakes on a big and ambitious project, so I thought that the easiest game genre to release would be a puzzle. Nonetheless, I enjoyed developing it because I could work together with my girlfriend and design this game using just paper, pen and sometimes dried peas while I was at home, on a bed or even on a bus.

The reason I made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301830/Shatris_Infinite_Puzzles/]Shatris[/url], however, was because I wanted to improve on the previous game. I felt like I didn't push it to its full potential and I wanted to make something that is similar, but better. I wholeheartedly believe that I managed to achieve that, but obviously it's not my opinion that matters. :) Thus, in case you're interested in puzzle games, I hope that you'll try it out yourselves and share your thoughts with me.

Now I finally feel like I've learned enough to start something ambitious and I hope to meet you again in 2021. :) I have a few prototypes ready, but I still haven't decided what exactly the upcoming game of mine will look like. However, there's a 90% chance that it will be controller-based and 2 players will be able to play it on the same couch.

Thank you for reading this announcement, I wish each single one of you to have fantastic winter holidays and only the best of luck in the upcoming year!

Yours forever,
Ivan Zlobin (Khud0)

notes.title: v1.05 - Easy life and better performance!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

During the last couple of weeks, I have been working on a "finalizing touch" for Grizzland. I added some features that were suggested or inspired by our wonderful community to make this grizzled world a cozy place to be.

[h1]Some "hidden" functions are now available in the game itself (previously you could only access them by tweaking the game files):[/h1]
- V-Sync and Text Speed were added to the game settings.
- You can now delete the save files and reset a speedrun from the "save file choosing screen" (inspired by question from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/AltariaDemon]Twix[/url]).
- The 2 hidden NPCs (you won't find them on the map) can now resurrect all the bosses and activate "invisible walls" mode. The latter will expire upon death.
- You no longer have to "stand on" the in-game Radio to listen to its music.
- Brightness was removed from settings (because it was dumb :D).
- Snow effect will last until player dies or enters the Castle.
- You can now change the localization files in Steam_Files_Folder > Grizzland and the results will be loaded into the game. However, I believe that the files will be replaced with each update, so please keep a copy of them somewhere if you decide to change something in them. :)

[h1]Miscellaneous:[/h1]
- Prices in the shop are now shown in coins, not hearts. (Reported by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/UunicoyY/]UNICOY[/url]);
- You should no longer be able to hold the Jump button to generate infinite amounts of particles and annoying jump sounds if you're standing right under the wall/slope;	
- The game's stability and performance should be much better now.
- Saving/Loading processes are now asynchronous and happen less often. 
- If you had previously unlocked an achievement in offline mode and still haven't got it on Steam, you might lose this progress.
- Gamepad tooltips were added in a couple of new places.
- You can now see visited secret rooms in "Journal" - "Notes".
- Secret Magnet will only "show" secrets you haven't found and secret rooms you haven't visited.
	
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
- A rare issue which caused players to waste money in the shop without getting the item should no longer appear;
- Self-destructing while your arrow is on the screen should no longer crash the game. (Reported by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/UunicoyY/]UNICOY[/url]);

[h1]Speedrun Related:[/h1]
- Timer will now show "more accurate" time. It is now updating more often and the format has been changed to the proper "00:00" (instead of "00:0", for example).
- The special event/cutscene on level 5 should no longer be triggered in Speedrun mode. 

I hope that you will enjoy the update! :)

Yours forever,
Khud0

notes.title: v1.04 - Slovak, invisible walls mode and boss resurrection!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

A great comrade of mine, Tomáš Lichanec a.k.a. Toren, translated Grizzland to Slovak! I never expected this game to support such a diversity of languages and I am extremely thankful to him for his work.

Even though it turned out that Steam doesn't support Slovak yet (which was a huge disappointment, because I can't add store text and the achievement descriptions Toren made), all of you CZ/SK players can now enjoy the in-game translation from your compatriot.

I also added 2 secret commands (for true hackers! :D) for everyone who supported the project and dedicated some time to play Grizzland.

The first one is an option to respawn all of the bosses with one line (instead of having to search through an entire save file). The second one turns off (almost) all of the tiles in the game. See if you can beat Grizzland without seeing the walls! I, personally, had a ton of fun playing the game this way, it's like re-experiencing from a completely different perspective.

I also spent many hours trying to make custom palettes, but the way I made the game basically doesn't allow me to do this (at least, not with my brains, sorry).

To use the 2 aforementioned commands, press Win+R (open Run application), type "%appdata%" (wihtout quotes), find a folder AppData\Local\, open a "Config.ini" file and slap the following somewhere at the bottom of all the text in the document.

For "Invisible Wall" mode, the lines are:
[Tiles]
Hide="1"

Next, just switch rooms (menu, game, save files etc) in-game and the tiles will disappear. You can see a gif of how the game will look like without the walls here: [url=https://twitter.com/Khud0Steam/status/1168181612686827524?s=20]Twitter Post[/url]

To reset the bosses, type:
[Config]
Reset_Bosses="1"

After (or before) that, open any save file (in the game) and wait for a few seconds. You will be killed and the bosses will be respawned (affects only the save file you are playing).

WARNING! It would be a good idea to copy your save files before doing anything with them, including typing the commands above. I am not sure what they may break.

Finally, many people who played with a controller were confused by "Hold (buttonName) to do something" strings in the game, which were designed for keyboard only. Thus, I added a small sign showing the corresponding gamepad controls for these occasions.

I hope that at least one person will find the update useful and fun to check out! If you are going to give it a try, you should know that all of the work, required to deliver updates to the game is done only because you're with me, dear player. :grizzland_heart:

Yours forever,
Khud0
